title: This pile of dirt has air conditioning
headline: THIS PILE OF DIRT HAS AIR CON

shots.text: This pile of dirt has air conditioning.
Termites built it, out of mud and spit.
Hot air rises out through chimneys... and cool air gets pulled in below.
Inside, they farm their own food: a fungus garden.
And deep in the middle, the queen lays an egg every three seconds.
That's about thirty thousand a day.
She can keep that up for twenty years... all inside this pile of dirt.

youtube.title: This Pile of Dirt Has Air Conditioning 😳 #shorts
youtube.description:
Termite mounds can stand taller than a person, and the insects that build them are smaller than a grain of rice 🐜

The mound is built from soil, saliva and droppings, and it works like a set of lungs: warm, stale air from the nest rises up through the chimneys, and fresh air is drawn in lower down. Deep inside, the termites grow a fungus on chewed-up plants and eat it. In the middle sits the queen, who can lay tens of thousands of eggs a day and live for around twenty years.

🐜 Would you go near one? Tell me in the comments.
